wp_sidebar_description.why: a registered sidebar's description through wp_kses by name

wp_unregister_sidebar_widget.why: its action, then the widget out of the three global registries plugins read

wp_widget_rss_output.why: the RSS widget's list markup, its item count rule and error messages

wp_widget_rss_process.why: cleans the RSS widget's settings and checks its feed
